jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nevoya:


Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.

About The Role:

The Enterprise Sales Executive owns the front half of Nevoya's revenue engine: finding, winning, and launching new customers. This is not a lead-gen seat. You carry the deal from first outreach through signed MSA, first load, and a clean handoff to Operations. You'll sell asset-based EV capacity directly to shippers and select 3PL partners, with a mandate to grow contract freight and shift revenue mix toward direct-shipper relationships.

You'll own the RFP process end to end, convert spot and project freight into committed volume, and run new lane launches so every go-live hits its committed date with no surprises for the customer or Ops. You'll also lead MSA negotiation with new customers, working within Nevoya's contracting standards and escalating material exceptions when needed.

This is a numbers-owned seat. Success is measured in new logos closed, contracted revenue, RFP win rate, on-time lane launches, and days from signature to first load. You'll need to understand asset-based trucking economics, want to build rather than inherit, and have the capacity to run multiple enterprise pursuits and onboardings at once without dropping balls.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the full-cycle pursuit of new shipper and 3PL logos on national networks

  • Build and manage your own pipeline in Attio: prospecting, qualification, discovery, proposal, close

  • Sell against Nevoya's ICP of high-density, closed-loop-friendly freight on corridors where EV economics win

  • Own the end-to-end RFP process: intake, lane analysis, pricing coordination, submission, and follow-through

  • Partner with Commercial Intelligence on lane-level cost modeling and with the VP of Commercial on margin strategy

  • Build and maintain a repeatable RFP playbook covering bid/no-bid criteria, response templates, and win/loss tracking

  • Convert spot and project freight into committed, contracted volume

  • Expand existing accounts onto new lanes and deepen wallet share with dedicated and contract structures

  • Drive the direct-shipper revenue mix in line with company strategy

  • Own new customer onboarding from signature through first load and stabilization

  • Own and continuously improve the New Lane Launch Playbook, including requirements gathering, charging and routing validation with Ops, and driver and equipment readiness

  • Own the Sales-to-Ops handoff SOP with clear swim lanes for who does what, from close through steady-state

  • Ensure complete, accurate handoff documentation for every new lane, including rates, accessorials, appointment protocols, contacts, and escalation paths

  • Close the loop post-launch by gathering Ops feedback and feeding it back into the playbook

  • Lead MSA and carrier agreement negotiation with new customers

  • Flag and negotiate key commercial terms such as liability, indemnity, declared value, payment terms, and volume commitments, escalating material exceptions to the VP of Commercial

  • Maintain a library of negotiated positions and fallback language to accelerate future deals

What You'll Bring To The Table:

  • 10+ years in freight or logistics sales, with asset-based carrier, dedicated or contract sales, or enterprise 3PL business development strongly preferred

  • A demonstrated track record closing new logos and growing contract freight with shippers

  • Experience running or responding to transportation RFPs, including lane-level pricing collaboration

  • Comfort negotiating MSAs and carrier agreements, and judgment on which terms matter and when to escalate

  • Operational fluency from having launched lanes or accounts before, so you know what a clean handoff looks like

  • CRM discipline in Attio, HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar, with a pipeline that's always current

  • An understanding of asset-based trucking economics: cost per mile, utilization, deadhead, accessorials, and why disciplined pricing beats volume at any cost

  • The drive to own a number, hunt new logos, and be accountable for the launch, not just the signature

  • The organization to run 5+ active enterprise pursuits, an RFP calendar, and 2-3 concurrent onboardings without dropping balls

Desired Experience:

  • EV or sustainability freight exposure

  • TX or CA market knowledge

  • Desire to work at an EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating Style) organization

At Nevoya, we believe diverse teams build better solutions.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you're excited about our mission but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or another role.

If you have any other questions please email our Recruiting Team directly @ careers@nevoya.com

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nevoya:


Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.

About The Role:

Nevoya is looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to own and grow relationships with our largest and most strategic customers. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth within current accounts, managing day to day customer relationships, and building the kind of trust that turns a single lane into a multi lane, multi year partnership.

You will be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, balancing tactical issue resolution with longer term account strategy. This includes running QBRs, tracking account health, expanding margin, and multi threading into enterprise accounts so relationships do not live or die with one contact.

This is a highly cross functional role that touches sales, operations, and customer experience, and is well suited to someone who enjoys owning outcomes end to end.

What You'll Do:

  • Own net revenue growth across your account portfolio, tracking growth year over year and quarter over quarter

  • Drive upsell and cross sell opportunities within existing accounts, including new lanes and service lines

  • Manage renewals and protect account revenue retention through contract expiration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries and escalations, meeting response time targets

  • Maintain a healthy issue backlog and manage resolution time by severity

  • Run scheduled account touchpoints and check ins on a consistent cadence

  • Prepare and deliver QBRs and scorecards on time and with accurate data

  • Track action items generated in QBRs and drive them to closure before the next review

  • Monitor account level margin and identify opportunities for margin improvement over time

  • Lead rate renegotiations and cost to serve reduction initiatives

  • Capture accessorial and detention revenue that is owed but often missed

  • Map stakeholders across each account to build multi threaded relationships beyond a single point of contact

  • Manage executive level touchpoints and reduce the frequency of escalations requiring senior leadership involvement

  • Build and maintain an account health score incorporating volume, margin, service, and satisfaction

  • Identify and resolve score impacting incidents, including appeals when appropriate

  • Track NPS or CSAT per account and generate customer references and case studies

  • Drive EDI and API integration completion for accounts, minimizing exceptions post launch

  • Reduce service failures and improve customer effort by proactively identifying and implementing account improvements

What You'll Bring To The Table:

  • 7 plus years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related revenue owning role, ideally in freight, logistics, or supply chain, with a focus on enterprise or large strategic accounts

  • A track record of growing revenue within existing accounts, not just maintaining them

  • Comfort owning both the relationship and the numbers behind it, including margin and pricing

  • Experience running structured account reviews such as QBRs, with the discipline to follow through on action items

  • Strong organizational skills to manage a portfolio of accounts with competing priorities

  • Ability to multi thread within enterprise accounts and build relationships beyond a single contact

  • Comfort with data, including tracking KPIs, building simple health scores, and spotting trends

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to navigate difficult conversations and escalations calmly

  • A proactive mindset, identifying and solving problems before they become escalations

Desired Experience:

  • Familiarity with EDI and API integrations in a logistics or TMS environment

  • Experience with drayage, intermodal, or asset based trucking operations

  • Exposure to contract negotiation or pricing strategy

  • Experience building or maintaining account health scoring frameworks

  • MBA or other advanced degree

At Nevoya, we believe diverse teams build better solutions.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you're excited about our mission but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or another role.

If you have any other questions please email our Recruiting Team directly @ careers@nevoya.com

jobs.title: AI Operations Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Nevoya:


Nevoya is North America's leading next-generation electric trucking carrier, transforming logistics through AI-native operations and relentless customer focus. The company builds and uses proprietary technology to deliver zero-emissions carrier services to Fortune 500 shippers with superior economics and service to legacy diesel operators. The company has operations in California and Texas, and is backed by globally-renowned investors including Lowercarbon Capital.

About the Role:

This is a foundational hire. You will do different aspects of dispatching in trucking — without needing any trucking experience. You’ll keep real freight moving for real customers: assigning loads, communicating with drivers, handling exceptions, and solving the problems of the day.

The reason this works is you. You are AI-native — AI is your default way of researching, troubleshooting, and getting work done — and you have the critical thinking to notice when the playbook is wrong and the initiative to propose the fix. You’ll work directly with engineering and product to automate the repetitive parts of the job, so the role keeps getting smarter.

You’ll get a lot of direction, coaching, and ownership early. Do this well and the role is a launchpad: people who build the operational foundation here will grow into bigger roles across the company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Run daily dispatch execution from our playbook: load assignment, driver communication, check-calls, and exception handling

  • Keep loads covered and customers informed, escalating with judgment when something can’t wait

  • Use AI tools daily to research, troubleshoot, draft, analyze, and automate your own work

  • Improve the playbook as you go — document what works, flag what doesn’t, and ship a better process every week

  • Call out problems early and come with proposed solutions, not just escalations

  • Partner with engineering and product to turn recurring manual work into automated workflows

  • Track the KPIs of your operation — load coverage, on-time performance, driver utilization — and use them to improve

What You’ll Bring:

  • A recent degree or 1–2 years of work experience — high-performing new grads encouraged to apply

  • AI-native habits: you already use AI as your default tool for learning, research, and producing work

  • Sharp critical thinking — you spot what’s broken, ask why, and bring a proposed answer

  • Hungry and coachable: you want direction, feedback, and a steep learning curve

  • Strong written and verbal communication — you’ll be talking to drivers, customers, and engineers in the same hour

  • Organized and calm under pressure; comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities

  • No trucking, logistics, or dispatch experience required

Nice to Have:

  • Internship or early experience in operations, logistics, supply chain, or a fast-moving startup

  • Comfort with data — spreadsheets, SQL, or light scripting

  • Spanish language proficiency, a meaningful asset in our operating markets

At Nevoya, we believe diverse teams build better solutions.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you're excited about our mission but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or another role.

If you have any other questions please email our Recruiting Team directly @ careers@nevoya.com
